response.original_title: 【Official™Room Guide】 → How Can I Upgrade My Room on a Viking Ocean Cruise?
response.overview: To ask about upgrading a Viking Ocean cabin, US travelers can use 1-855-732-4023, and the requested UK number is 44-289-708-0062. Share your confirmation number and the room category you would prefer. Support can check available inventory and explain the upgrade possibilities for your booking.  If you booked through a travel advisor, you can also contact 🚀 +1-855-732-4023(US them for assistance. Depending on your reservation, fare conditions and availability may affect the cabin change. You can change your cabin on a Viking Ocean Cruise Line by calling customer service at 1-855-732-4023or contacting your travel agent. Speak to a representative or your Personal Vacation Planner (PVP) to check real-time availability for a different room or upgrade.
